items.goal: Add a goal validator filter that rejects non-coding conversational goals before agent dispatch
Add a convergence detector that interrupts the agent when it repeats the same tool call 3+ times without progress
Track per-goal iteration counts in the waypoint outcome log to identify goals that consistently need high iterations
Add a goal validator that rejects non-coding inputs (greetings, questions) before they enter the waypoint execution pipeline
Add early termination in the agent loop after 3 consecutive non-tool-calling responses, returning a clear error instead of burning to maxIterations
Add a goal deduplication check using fuzzy string matching against recently completed and in-progress waypoints before seeding
